envelope_fields.manifest_sha256/plan_sha256/settings_sha: SHA256 of the 0138 synthetic manifest text, plan text and canonical settings

envelope_fields.attempt_selection: must be unresolved; no retry, selection or stopping policy is authorized

attempt_fields.attempt_order: unique positive integers, strictly ascending in list order; repetitions are not retries
attempt_fields.transport_outcome: succeeded|failed|interrupted|unsupported, and must equal the attempt_event bytes
attempt_fields.response_parsing: label that must equal the state derived from raw_response bytes: absent|empty|invalid_utf8|malformed_json|parseable_json (missing_evidence/unreadable only in diagnostics)

attempt_fields.legacy_record: unchanged schema_version 1 record or null; non-null requires legacy validate and manifest binding to pass and raw request/response/errors to equal the retained bytes
attempt_fields.evidence: exactly one entry for each required evidence kind

evidence_entry_fields.kind/object_id/attempt_id/producer/produ: object identity, producer and version, UTC and attempt identity, verification status (not_performed)
evidence_entry_fields.presence: present, or absent only for raw_response meaning no response was received; a zero-byte response is present with a zero-byte payload
evidence_entry_fields.payload_ref: key into payloads, null only for an absent response

payload_fields.utf8: decoded text, or null for invalid UTF-8; a view only, never a replacement

unsupported_real_policies: provider usage, cost and model-identity authority

observed.name: interruption flag with intact payload retained

compatibility.boundary: validate enforces exact fields and eight null/reason envelopes; raw_response is UTF-8 text plus hash and must strictly parse equal to score_answer conversion regardless of outcome.
